scope: User-declarable, table-storable types for MySQL 5.7/8.0/8.4 and PostgreSQL 15/16/17. Parameters and catalog-created types are represented by axes or discovery rules.

per_type_qualification.web_evidence_scope: Web plan receipts qualify an actual source-to-sink Web route. Type compatibility qualification composes independently verified per-type Source, ChangeEvent, and Sink evidence with the offline 6x6 route matrix; exact same-version MySQL routes use this mode when no distinct sink server is configured.

route_qualification_modes.LIVE_WEB_E2E: An artifact-bound per-type Web plan receipt proves target probe, explicit selection, risk confirmation, saved plan, and start gate.
route_qualification_modes.COMPONENTS_COMPOSED_MYSQL_SELF_ROUTE: The exact per-type MySQL Source and ChangeEvent evidence composes with the same MySQL Sink's per-type offline and live readback and the offline 6x6 route result. This proves adapter compatibility but is not a live Web route test.

postgresql_catalog_oid.catalog_query: SELECT n.nspname, t.typname, t.oid, t.typtype, t.typcategory, t.typbasetype, t.typelem, t.typrelid, t.typarray, t.typsend::regproc::text AS send_function, t.typreceive::regproc::text AS receive_function FROM pg_catalog.pg_type t JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace WHERE t.typisdefined ORDER BY n.nspname, t.typname
postgresql_catalog_oid.binding_rule: Resolve and persist the actual OID with namespace/type identity for each server and definition fingerprint; do not assume OIDs are portable across clusters or infer them from a display name.

dynamic_type_classes.discovery: pg_catalog.pg_type where typisdefined and typelem is nonzero; record element type OID, array OID, delimiter, dimensions, and element definition digest
pg_type.typtype = 'd'; recursively record base type, typmod, collation, NOT NULL and domain constraints
pg_type.typtype = 'e'; record ordered pg_enum labels and definition digest

pg_type.typtype = 'c'; record ordered non-dropped pg_attribute members and recursive type identities. Keep exact catalog mappings for definitions depending on pseudotypes, but mark those definitions NOT_APPLICABLE_NON_STORABLE and exclude only their user-table DML route tests with an explicit dependency-path reason.
pg_range; record subtype, collation, canonicalization and optional multirange identity
pg_type joined to pg_namespace and pg_depend/pg_extension; record extension name/version and input/output/send/receive functions where visible
Defined non-pg_catalog, non-pseudo base types (typtype = 'b'); record schema identity, I/O and send/receive functions, typmod behavior, and extension ownership if any
All defined, non-pseudotype pg_catalog rows not matched to a named static entry; unexpected rows become MISSING_IMPLEMENTATION
dynamic_type_classes.catalog_query: SELECT n.nspname, t.typname, t.typtype, t.typcategory, t.typbasetype, t.typelem, t.typrelid, t.typarray, t.typreceive::regproc::text AS receive_function, t.typsend::regproc::text AS send_function FROM pg_catalog.pg_type t JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'pg_catalog' AND t.typisdefined AND t.typtype <> 'p' ORDER BY n.nspname, t.typname

dynamic_type_classes.discovery: Any observed INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS native declaration or binlog wire type not matched to this inventory; no fallback mapping is permitted

excluded_type_classes.rule: pg_type.typtype = 'p' or not typisdefined; they are not valid stored table-column types
SQL syntax or attributes that do not create an independent stored value type are tracked as metadata/aliases
serial/smallserial/bigserial are column-creation macros over integer plus sequence/default metadata, not independent runtime types
